headers.Subject: Welcome to ExampleCorp - your first day

body_text:
Dear new colleague,

We are delighted to welcome you to ExampleCorp. Your first day will be on 1 September 2026 at 09:00 at 230 Example Street, Sample City.

Please bring your ID and two passport-size photos for your badge.

Best regards,
HR Team
